target: 3.2.1 On Focus and 3.2.2 On Input (both A)
observed_behavior: Focusing a component must not initiate a change of context; changing a UI setting must not automatically change context unless advised before use.
context: WCAG 2.2 W3C Recommendation Dec 12 2024; exact criterion level and exceptions
limitations: The two separate A criteria have different conditions; neither bans all in-field validation feedback.
